[{"sha":"da74074e5a06b774d2b728814a56dfcaf01a2a45","node_id":"C_kwDOEWzLNdoAKGRhNzQwNzRlNWEwNmI3NzRkMmI3Mjg4MTRhNTZkZmNhZjAxYTJhNDU","commit":{"author":{"name":"Michael Grosse Huelsewiesche","email":"mihuelsewiesche@twilio.com","date":"2026-10-21T01:04:55Z"},"committer":{"name":"GitHub","email":"noreply@github.com","date":"2026-10-21T01:04:55Z"},"message":"fix: don't round numeric-looking string values read from storage (#1403)

## Problem

`?ajs_aid=7689174720735493772` ends up as anonymousId
`7689174720735494000` (a rounded number).

`queryString()` passes the string through correctly, and
`CookieStorage.set` writes it to the cookie verbatim. The loss is on
read: `CookieStorage.get` and `LocalStorage.get` run `JSON.parse` on
every value, so an all-digit string comes back as a JS number. Above
`Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER` that number is rounded, and `getConsistent`'s
legacy number-to-string coercion then stringifies the already-rounded
value. Cookie wins over localStorage in `getConsistent`, so the rounded
value is what `user.anonymousId()` returns.

## Fix

New `parseStoredValue()` shared by both stores: a parsed number is only
accepted if `String(parsed) === raw`; otherwise the raw string is
returned. Also stops `"1e3"` -> `1000`, `"1.50"` -> `1.5`.

Numbers that round-trip exactly (e.g. `"12345"`) still parse to numbers,
so the AJS 1.0 legacy numeric-id coercion in
`getAndSync`/`getConsistent` is unchanged. Objects, booleans, `null`,
and non-JSON strings take the same path as before.

## Behavior change

Stored values that parse to a number but don't print back identically
(`"1.0"`, `" 12"`, `"1e3"`, `"-0"`) are now returned as the raw string
instead of a normalised number. For ids this is the correct behavior; I
found no caller relying on the old normalisation.

## Tests

Failing tests were written first (cookie, localStorage, `User`) and
reproduced the exact value from the report. Added a unit test for the
helper. `tsc` clean; full `packages/browser` jest run has 2 unrelated
failures: `Custom cookie params > allows for overriding keys` (cookie
snapshot gets a stray `"; "` prefix, fails without the source change)
and a `Remote Middleware` test that passes in isolation.

installed in my worktree; I ran `lint-staged` (passes) and `tsc`
